_note: Hand-approved Instagram handles for artists the festival site has no bio page for. scripts/backfill-artist-media.py reads `artists` and writes them into hellodancefest-2026.json. JSON has no comments, which is what `source` is for. scripts/collect-ig-handles.mjs proposes candidates to put here.
